fusions.name: Paid Out in Lengths
fusions.desc: Casts a link at the first enemy it meets for 6 damage, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of that. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Fan of Fetters
fusions.desc: Lashes a fan of chains ahead of you, which deals 12 damage to everything within 4 tiles, stuns it for 1 second and has a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bound Fast
fusions.desc: Binds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: No Slipping Free
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them.
